name: own metal
tagline: sites whose owner runs the whole stack — the web page, and everything behind it
rules: Your site is served from hardware you control. A box at home, a rack you rent, a Pi on a shelf — not a platform that builds and hosts it for you.
You run at least one other service yourself: git, mail, chat, a game server, a store, whatever. The web page is the front door, not the whole house.
It's personal. A company's status page is not in the spirit.
Show the ring links somewhere a visitor can find them.
No bigotry, no hate, no scraped slop.
